nodes.name: permission-auto-respond.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helper module deciding whether an incoming permission request should be auto-answered, based on persisted auto-accept state, the requesting session's parent lineage, and directory-scoped acceptance. Used by the permission context to implement auto-accept for parent/subagent sessions.

nodes.name: acceptKey
nodes.summary: Builds the persisted-storage key (base64-encoded sessionID/directory pair) under which a session's auto-accept flag is stored.

nodes.name: directoryAcceptKey
nodes.summary: Builds the storage key for directory-wide auto-accept flags, scoping acceptance to an entire working directory.

nodes.name: isDirectoryAutoAccepting
nodes.summary: Returns whether auto-accept is currently enabled for every session in the given directory.

nodes.name: sessionLineage
nodes.summary: Walks the parent chain of a session (following parentID links with cycle protection) and returns the list of ancestor session IDs ending at the requested session, so permission decisions can honor acceptance granted to any ancestor.

nodes.name: autoRespondsPermission
nodes.summary: Decides whether a specific permission request qualifies for auto-response by checking acceptance for the session or any of its ancestors, plus directory-wide acceptance.

nodes.name: permission.tsx
nodes.summary: SolidJS context serving as the app's permission-request hub: subscribes to server permission events, tracks pending prompts, dedupes responses, auto-accepts requests when enabled per session or directory (draining the backlog on enable), and exposes respond/once/always/deny actions plus auto-accept toggles. Delegates lineage-aware auto-respond decisions to permission-auto-respond helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the createSimpleContext use/provider pair convention; responded-request dedup is a Map keyed by permission id with time-based pruning, and enable-version counters guard against racing a disable while the backlog drain is in flight.

nodes.name: isNonAllowRule
nodes.summary: Type guard detecting permission config rules that are not plain allow rules (arrays, deny/ask objects), used to decide when the UI must keep prompting despite configured permissions.

nodes.name: platform.tsx
nodes.summary: Defines the Platform capability interface abstracting web vs desktop (Tauri) differences — link opening, notifications, history navigation, file/directory pickers, storage, update checks, WSL/display-backend settings, clipboard — and a simple context provider that injects the active implementation.
nodes.languageNotes: Classic capability object pattern: optional methods (openFilePickerDialog, getWslEnabled, parseMarkdown, etc.) mark desktop-only features, letting web code feature-detect instead of branching on platform checks.

nodes.name: prompt.tsx
nodes.summary: Per-session prompt composer state: draft text, file selections, and context items with attached comments, backed by a persisted SolidJS store with structural equality checks (to avoid spurious saves), deep clone helpers, stable content-hash keys for context items, and an LRU cache of per-session stores with dispose/prune lifecycle.

nodes.name: isPartEqual
nodes.summary: Structurally compares two prompt parts (text plus file selections) so persistence only fires when draft content actually changed.

nodes.name: isPromptEqual
nodes.summary: Compares full prompt drafts part-by-part for deep equality; exported for reuse by persistence and UI logic.

nodes.name: contextItemKey
nodes.summary: Derives a stable identity key for a context item from its comment text and a truncated checksum of its content, enabling dedup and keyed updates of attached-file items.

nodes.name: createPromptActions
nodes.summary: Builds the set/batch/reset action closures that mutate a prompt store, always cloning prompts before writes to keep the store immutable from the caller's perspective.

nodes.name: createPromptSession
nodes.summary: Creates the per-session prompt store backed by scoped persistence, wiring context-item add/remove/comment-update/replace actions and memoized draft state; instantiated under createRoot by the session cache.

nodes.name: sdk.tsx
nodes.summary: Directory-scoped SDK context: wraps the global SDK to produce a per-directory API client (throwOnError) and re-emits server events for that directory through a strongly-typed global emitter, so components can subscribe to individual event types.
nodes.languageNotes: The SDKEventMap mapped type ({ [key in Event["type"]]: Extract<Event, {type: key}> }) turns the SDK's discriminated event union into a typed emitter — a useful pattern for re-broadcasting tagged unions.

nodes.name: server.tsx
nodes.summary: Multi-server connection manager: resolves and dedupes the persisted server list, tracks per-server health via polling, holds active/expanded server UI state (open/close, expand/collapse, reorder, touch), and exports URL normalization/naming helpers used across the app.

nodes.name: normalizeServerUrl
nodes.summary: Normalizes user-entered server URLs: trims whitespace, defaults a missing scheme to http, and strips trailing slashes.

nodes.name: serverName
nodes.summary: Derives a display name for a server connection from its URL (scheme stripped, host+port kept), unless a display name override is set.

nodes.name: resolveServerList
nodes.summary: Merges stored server connections with runtime inputs into a deduplicated connection list keyed by ServerConnection.key, tolerating partially-invalid stored entries.

nodes.name: settings.tsx
nodes.summary: Persisted application settings store: font configuration for mono/sans/terminal faces (input accessors plus CSS font-family stacks with escaping and defaults), UI visibility toggles (file tree, navigation, search, status, terminal, reasoning summaries, progress bar), autosave/followup behavior, per-agent and permission/error filter rules with enable flags, and reset actions.

nodes.name: sync.tsx
nodes.summary: The app's per-directory data synchronization engine: loads and paginates session messages with cursor/limit metadata, merges optimistic message/part additions and removals into server pages, reconciles diffs and todos, dedupes in-flight fetches with retry, tracks seen sessions, and evicts least-recently-used session caches under a global limit. Exports the pure optimistic-merge helpers for testing.
nodes.languageNotes: Sorted message/part lists are maintained with Binary.search insertions instead of re-sorts, and solid-js store reconcile() keyed by id applies server pages with minimal reactivity churn — a good example of merging server data into fine-grained stores.

nodes.name: mergeParts
nodes.summary: Merges an incoming set of message parts into a sorted existing list, replacing same-id parts and inserting new ones at their binary-searched position.

nodes.name: mergeOptimisticPage
nodes.summary: Folds optimistic (locally-added) messages into a freshly fetched server page: matches by id/time, keeps optimistic parts that the server page doesn't yet cover, and reports which optimistic messages were confirmed so their markers can be cleared.

nodes.name: applyOptimisticAdd
nodes.summary: Pure draft mutation inserting an optimistic message into a session's sorted message list; exported for unit testing.

nodes.name: applyOptimisticRemove
nodes.summary: Pure draft mutation removing a message (by id or timestamp match) from a session's optimistic message list; exported for unit testing.

nodes.name: setOptimisticAdd
nodes.summary: Applies applyOptimisticAdd through the sync store's produce() so SolidJS reactivity records the insertion.

nodes.name: setOptimisticRemove
nodes.summary: Applies applyOptimisticRemove through the sync store's produce(), matching messages by id then falling back to timestamp comparison.

nodes.name: terminal-title.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny helpers for default terminal tab titles: renders the numbered title template, detects whether a title is still the unmodified default, and finds the lowest unused terminal number.

nodes.name: terminal.tsx
nodes.summary: Workspace terminal (PTY) manager: persists terminal tab state with legacy-state migration, creates/clones/closes/renames terminals through the SDK pty API, auto-removes exited terminals on server events, trims the tab list to a cap, and caches per-workspace sessions in a createRoot-based LRU cache with dispose/prune lifecycle.
nodes.languageNotes: The 226-line createWorkspaceTerminalSession factory assembles the whole terminal store/actions under an owner scope so the cache can dispose reactions via createRoot disposal — the same LRU-owner pattern used by prompt.tsx.

nodes.name: pty
nodes.summary: Coerces an unknown persisted value into a well-formed terminal record, defaulting ids/titles/dimensions and deriving the title number.

nodes.name: migrateTerminalState
nodes.summary: Migrates legacy persisted terminal state to the current shape: normalizes records, dedupes by id, and reconciles the active terminal id with the surviving list.

nodes.name: getTerminalServerScope
nodes.summary: Resolves which server connection a workspace's terminals are scoped to, preferring the current connection and falling back to platform/local defaults.

nodes.name: clearWorkspaceTerminals
nodes.summary: Clears a workspace's terminal sessions: disposes the cached session, removes persisted state, and sweeps legacy storage keys left by older formats.

nodes.name: createWorkspaceTerminalSession
nodes.summary: Builds the full per-workspace terminal store and action set: persisted state with migration, exited-terminal removal on server events, pty create/clone/update/remove SDK calls, title/number assignment, tab trimming, next/previous navigation, and reorder/move operations.

nodes.name: entry.tsx
nodes.summary: Web app entry point: constructs the web Platform implementation (localStorage-backed default server URL, browser notifications, history navigation, reload), optionally initializes Sentry, extracts and strips the auth_token URL parameter, and renders PlatformProvider + AppBaseProviders + AppInterface with the resolved server connection.

nodes.name: setStorage
nodes.summary: Writes (or removes, when given null) a value under a localStorage key with defensive try/catch around quota and serialization failures.

nodes.name: notify
nodes.summary: Sends a browser notification when the page is unfocused: requests permission, skips when the document has focus, and routes notification clicks through the shared handleNotificationClick deep-link handler.

nodes.name: env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient type declarations for Vite import.meta.env (opencode server host/port/channel, Sentry DSN/environment/release) plus a solid-js JSX module augmentation registering the sortable directive.

nodes.name: use-providers.ts
nodes.summary: Hook deriving provider views for the current directory's global sync store: the curated popular-providers list, connected providers, and providers with at least one ready model, all memoized off the directory route param.

nodes.name: useProviders
nodes.summary: Reads the directory from route params (base64-decoded), opens its global-sync child store, and returns memoized popular/connected/ready provider lists for the model picker UI.

nodes.languageNotes: Fallback composition is done with object spread ({ ...en, ...overrides }) in importing locales, so missing keys silently resolve to English.
